_doc: QUIET-DEFAULT-BUILD-1 baseline for scripts/check-default-build-quiet.py. This is ATTRIBUTED DEBT, not an approved list -- but unlike the 83-tag seed it replaces, every entry now carries a `keep` reason naming the harness code that parses it. History: VERIFY-INTEGRITY-3 measured 83 tags printing in a default build (nine repeating every 600 frames forever, four announcing switched-OFF features). QUIET-DEFAULT-BUILD-1 gated 70 of them behind MC2_DIAG_VERBOSE, taking a measured default-env mc2_10 run from 79 distinct tags / 439 diagnostic lines to 9 tags / 44 lines. The 9 that remain are load-bearing for verification itself: silencing them would blind the smoke harness, which is a worse failure than being noisy. Changing that is a harness-contract change and belongs to its own slice. The ratchet only ever tightens: gating a tag and removing it here is always correct; adding one requires a keep reason.

CAMERA.reason: Error-only, rate-limited: reports a failed camera invariant while retaining the last valid view; silent on healthy frames.

ABL_FATAL.reason: Error-only, once per distinct fatal message: owner-required ABL source context before callback suppression; silent on healthy missions.

ABL_FALLBACK.reason: Error-only, once per failed script instance: owner-required quarantine receipt proves a returning ABL fatal cannot silently spin an activation; silent on healthy missions.

HDR_OUTPUT v1.reason: Owner-required H2 once-per-present-chain display capability receipt; HDR smoke proof verifies actual SDR and the prospective HDR format without enabling HDR rendering.

GAME_RULES.reason: Owner-requested game-rules receipt: one line per mission start/load with the published snapshot of every sim rule (calledShots, pilotSkillWeight, salvage, cbillMultiplier); run_smoke.py parses it and HARD FAILs a run under non-default rules unless --allow-nondefault-rules (docs/game-rules.md).

WATER_QUALITY.reason: Owner-requested water-quality-options-1 mission-load receipt of effective reflection/detail settings and the legacy material switch; one line per mission load.

COMMAND_REPLAY.reason: Error-only: tools/command_replay.py requires record_failed reason= to reject a refused fixture during opt-in recording; silent outside a failed recording.

AUDIO_START.reason: Owner-requested audio-double-2 per-start path/channel/caller evidence; AudioBackend/start log counts plays but not pause or resume tests the count.

AUDIO_CUE.reason: Owner-requested audio-double-2 attribution of AUDIO_START memory-resource addresses to SFX, Betty and support packet IDs.

RENDER_WORLD.reason: Error-only: static-prop recipe allocation exhausted its handle partition; refusal must be loud before any registry mutation.

TREE_LOD_STATS.reason: Opt-in diagnostic: only prints under MC2_DIAG_TAGS=TREE_LOD_STATS (per-tier tree instance and triangle counts every 120 frames); silent in a default run.

TREE_LOD.reason: Error-only: printed when a tree LOD chain is malformed (too many levels, missing or mismatched distances, dark light tags); never printed on a healthy map. Lane proof greps it for zero.

TREE_IMPORT.reason: Error-only: printed when a tree GLB exceeds the importer size limit so the fallback is visible instead of silent.

EXIT.reason: Platform/WindowInput.cpp (moved unchanged from GameOS/gameos/gameos.cpp in R1-window): one stderr line when the game requests exit, so a silent quit is diagnosable in smoke logs.

CRASH.reason: GameOS/gameos/gos_crashpad.cpp: one stderr line at startup (crashpad handler started / NOT started) and, on Linux, a signal-safe line from the crash hook; scripts/smoke_lib crash evidence and scripts/crashpad_proof.py parse the [CRASH] lines to locate the minidump.

CRASHBUNDLE.reason: GameOS/gameos/gos_crashbundle.cpp prints only when recording a crash or unclean exit; tools/window_cycle.py and scripts/smoke_lib detect this tag to fail runs with crash evidence.

BUILD_FINGERPRINT v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/fingerprint.py parses this to prove the smoked exe matches the worktree HEAD. Silencing it disables DEPLOY_FINGERPRINT attribution -- the single strongest anti-'unverifiable work' control in the harness.

CONFIG v1.reason: Gates/gate.cpp dumpConfig: ONE summary line per start (set/nondefault/unregistered/badvalue counts) plus a line per env-set gate and each warning. The smoke runner forces MC2_CONFIG_STRICT=1 and reads these lines to prove which configuration was measured; per-row lines for unset gates only print under MC2_CONFIG_DUMP=all.

INSTR v1.reason: scripts/whatran.py and smoke_lib/gates.py parse the 'enabled:' banner to record which gates were armed for a run. smoke_lib/gates.py reports '[INSTR v1] banner absent' as a failure.

NO_GL_RUNTIME v1.reason: scripts/delivery-fixes.json native_backend_needle: the delivery grader requires this startup proof (context=none, opengl32/glew32 not loaded) in the binary and the log.

PERF v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/logparse.py parses avg_fps/p50_ms/p99_ms (oracle_report.py and smoke_with_screenshots.py, the other readers, were retired 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12). This is the perf regression signal.

QUADSETUP_SKIP v1.reason: Human-readable smoke oracle (fullyArmed=/skip=). Its parser smoke_lib/oracleparse.py was retired 2026-10-11 (owner ruling 2026-10-09 #11) with no replacement; the line stays until a gate owns it.

SIM_OVERLAP v1.reason: Prints only on an owner VIOLATION or at a worker/fatal crash (never in a clean run). scripts/video_decode_smoke.py fails the end row on the VIOLATION line; the FATAL bundle line names the thread and last site of an otherwise bare 0xC0000409.

SMOKE v1.reason: scripts/run_smoke.py, smoke_lib/runner.py and run_editor_playtest_smoke.py key their pass/fail verdict off the [SMOKE v1] line; run_editor_playtest_smoke.py requires it explicitly. This IS the harness's result channel.

TERRAIN_SHORELINE v1.reason: FAIL-LOUD by design (DEPLOY-CURRENT-1, mclib/terrain.cpp): only the sidecar NOT FOUND / load-failure lines print by default; LOADED is MC2_DIAGF. Prints once per mission load on maps without a cooked shoreline mask.

TIMING v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/logparse.py TIMING_RE parses event=/elapsed_ms= for load-phase timing.

VIDEO v1.reason: Regression floor of the video surface (owner ruling 2026-10-13, M1): one line per movie request, skip or play (campaign-start and won-mission pre-videos in code/missionbegin.cpp / logistics.cpp / logistics_begin.cpp, in-mission videos in controlgui_chat.cpp as event=play_requested), a few lines per session. Parsed by scripts/smoke_lib/logparse.py PRESENCE_RULES (an absence rule: tier1/tier2 mc2_10 must print an event=play_requested line or the row is red, bucket video_floor_missing; scripts/smoke_lib/gates.py applies it). The campaign-start pre_video line is not yet enforced: it needs a campaign-boot run, so until one exists the proof procedure greps it.

VK_PROFILE v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/vk_profile.py and logparse.py (MarkerBucket verdict=refused) parse the Vulkan device-profile verdict; printed once per start. The default backend became Vulkan on 2026-10-17.

VK_EXT v1.reason: GameOS/gameos/vulkan_context.cpp prints the optional extension-tier selection and its cache key once per start (twice when device creation retries without the tier); it is the receipt of which device config the on-disk shader cache is keyed on, next to [VK_PROFILE v1] and [VK_RT v1].

VK_EXT_KEY v1.reason: GameOS/gameos/vulkan_context.cpp prints once per start that the extension tier cache key was put in VkApplicationInfo (or could not be, or the retry without the tier made the instance again with key 0); the receipt that tier and plain configs never share a driver shader-cache key.

VRAM v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/vram.py parses the load_end / run_end GPU-memory lines into the smoke report and the perf baseline. GameOS/gameos/gpu_memory_report.cpp prints them only when the smoke harness or MC2_DIAG_VERBOSE asked for diagnostics (log() returns early otherwise), so a player's console stays quiet; this check grades a smoke log, which is why it sees the tag.

VK_RESIDENCY v1.reason: FAIL-LOUD by design (GameOS/gameos/vk_render_infra.cpp, vk_frame_ring.cpp, gos_vegetation.cpp, shadow_quality.h): the unconditional lines report a refused allocation, a degraded shadow quality or a vegetation placement cap the user's hardware forced; the budget summary line is MC2_DIAG_VERBOSE. No parser consumes it.

VRAM_ADAPTER v1.reason: Printed once before the first [VRAM v1] line, under the same smoke / MC2_DIAG_VERBOSE guard, and says which rule (luid or most_dedicated) picked the DXGI adapter the VRAM numbers come from; a reader of a VRAM figure on a two-GPU host needs it. No parser consumes it.

PERF_WINDOW v1.reason: GameOS/gameos/battle_bench.h emitPerfWindow(): printed once when the fixed sim-tick window closes (or at exit); scripts/smoke_lib/logparse.py parses it and scripts/smoke_lib/gates.py grades the per-pass draw ceilings against it (W125, temporal/perf lanes).

VK_GPU_PASSES v1.reason: GameOS/gameos/vk_gpu_profile.cpp: the always-armed GPU timestamp ring prints one arm line and one per-pass mean line every 120 frames; tools/terrain_perf_report.py and tools/perf/mission_cpu_profile.py parse the frame= lines. Gating it is a harness-contract change for its own slice (W125).

BENCH_DEVICE v1.reason: GameOS/gameos/vk_gpu_profile.cpp: one line at device creation naming the GPU, driver and API version the [VK_GPU_PASSES v1] numbers were measured on, so a perf receipt carries its device. No parser consumes it yet (W125).

VK_RT_SELFTEST.reason: GameOS/gameos/vk_rt_selftest.cpp: printed only when the MC2_VK_RT_SELFTEST=1 opt-in diagnostic env asked for the ray-tracing GPU self-test (the gate is the guard; the default env never reaches it); the single PASS/FAIL/skipped verdict line is the receipt, so it must not hide behind a second MC2_DIAG_TAGS opt-in.

VK_ISLAND_INIT.reason: GameOS/gameos/vk_island_fail_policy.h: printed only when a Vulkan island's init fails (once per wait, once per retry/degrade/fatal decision), naming the island, action and VkResult; a healthy device prints none. It is the receipt for a missing effect or a fatal exit, so it must not hide behind MC2_DIAG_VERBOSE.

SCREEN_SHOT.reason: code/missionbegin.cpp: printed only when the MC2_SHOT_SCREEN proof knob asked for a front-end screen capture (the knob is the guard; the default env never reaches it); the single OK/FAIL verdict line is the receipt scripts/screen_shot.py parses, so it must not hide behind a second MC2_DIAG_TAGS opt-in.

CONTENT_COOK.reason: mclib/content_ir.cpp: one line per content-cache cook/hit (cache=hit|miss); scripts/kit_payload.py parses key= from it. Printed only when a glTF/FBX shape goes through the content cache, never in a stock default run.

LOADOUT_MIGRATE.reason: code/logisticsdata_save.cpp: printed only when a loaded save's loadout changed because the chassis layout moved on (moved/dropped components, C-bill refund, replaced variant); a current-layout save prints none. It is the receipt for refunded C-bills, so it must not hide behind MC2_DIAG_VERBOSE; tools/campaign_save_roundtrip.py proofs read it.
